inventory_audit.description: Reconcile every Wave 6 operation with its visible control, production owner, material outcomes, exact return, executed evidence, and design disposition before remediation.

required.description: Run the documented clean-start and reset path and retain a stable URL with an in-product guide and representative Project.
Execute Project profile selection, versioned taxonomy reads, paired-profile behavior, and safe unknown-profile handling through production owners.
Execute profile choice and taxonomy inspection and verify registered terms and actions across all core task surfaces.
Submit an actual prompt from the production Petra UI through a certified model role and retain context, streaming/result, references, limitations, and identity evidence.
Execute model failure and disconnect/replay from the Petra composer while preserving the draft, context, Work identity, and honest recovery.
Execute Work start, required input, steering or priority, cancellation, retry/resume assessment, and exact results through production commands.
Complete the Work task from its visible controls with meaningful stages, inputs, activity, resources, outcomes, recovery, and exact destinations.
Prove direct and Petra-mediated actions use the same registered identities, authorization, commands, idempotency, and outcomes.
Execute SuggestedAction preview/invocation, durable interrupt response, Review correction/decision, and exact return through the application UI.
Execute source registration or reuse, processing Work, exact inspection, new-revision addition, Project-link removal, eligible local-copy deletion, and recovery through distinct visible controls.
Execute candidate/basis correction, reject, defer/reopen, refresh, separation, preparation, Apply, and member outcomes from Review.
Execute contextual Graph, selection, Details, exact source, expansion/filter/save, textual peer, correction preview, and return without losing task context.
Execute History inspection, canonical effect, recovery assessment, governed Revert preview or result, and return to updated Brief.
Run the complete in-product guided workflow through the stable production URL without repository reports, fixtures, or developer-only instructions.
Record and disposition a product-design review of hierarchy, navigation, typography, spacing, density, interaction, responsive behavior, and cross-surface coherence.
Apply Felicity to all core labels, instructions, status, outcomes, errors, recovery, and the in-product guide without weakening contract meaning.
Execute the guided path at supported widths and text scales with keyboard, visible focus, browser semantics, non-color meaning, reduced motion, and touch targets.
Execute stale, partial, failed, offline, reconnecting, projection-lag, permission-loss, and unknown-effect states without lost work or false success.
Run gate:wave6:user-testable with every milestone-6 operation live and bound to an executed evidence artifact.
Critique the final application for fake controls, fixture fallback, client/model authority, dead ends, hidden recovery, duplicate effects, slide-like presentation, and unsupported completion claims.
Run the complete repository, fresh-store, model, restart/replay, and operation gates on clean pushed backend and design branches.
Record the final stable-URL guided workflow on the integrated tree and publish exact starting state, expected outcomes, reset, and known limits.
The user completes the guided live workflow and explicitly accepts the application checkpoint; automated workers cannot satisfy this record.
